description: React component for a billing system interface, including product search, cart management, bill generation, and printing functionality.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Saves billing history via API call if bill number exists.

methods.name: handleAddToCart
methods.description: Adds selected product to cart with specified quantity.

methods.name: handleRemoveFromCart
methods.description: Removes item from cart by ID.

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates total amount of items in cart.

methods.name: generateBillNumber
methods.description: Fetches last bill number from API and sets new bill number.

methods.name: handleGenerateBillNumber
methods.description: Generates formatted date and calls API to generate new bill number.

methods.name: handlePrint
methods.description: Prepares and triggers print of the bill, then saves history.

methods.name: handleSearchChange
methods.description: Updates product suggestions based on search input.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation and selection in search suggestions.

methods.name: onPressEnter
methods.description: Focuses customer name input on Enter key if 'Bill From' is filled.
